guarantees.claim: encoded_key_block[0] is always assigned to {encoded_key[0], encode_bytepad}.
When EnMasking is true, encoded_key_block[1] is assigned to {encoded_key[1], 16'h0}.

assumptions.claim: When EnMasking is false, encoded_key_block[1] must be driven by other logic or remain unused.
assumptions.risk: If downstream reads encoded_key_block[1] while it is undriven, x-propagation may corrupt key material or cause undefined behavior.

uncertain_points.claim: The legal parameter value EnMasking=0 leaves encoded_key_block[1] completely undriven in this chunk; it is unclear whether downstream logic expects a valid value.
uncertain_points.risk: If encoded_key_block[1] carries key material and is consumed downstream when masking is disabled, x-propagation could leak secret data or break functional correctness.
